ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 75% high-intensity (white/light grey) interior surface area surrounded by a 25% low-intensity (black) perimeter and focal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central lobes exhibit high-intensity white pixels. Low-intensity black pixels form a continuous boundary along the lateral and trailing edges. A dense black concentration is visible at the insertion point (peduncle) extending into the median notch. Notable isolated low-intensity circular blobs are located at the mid-upper section of the left lobe and the lower-mid section of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 42 degrees; depth extends significantly toward the peduncle insertion.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations along the entire trailing edge. Left lobe exhibits a major jagged indentation approximately 1/3 from the outer tip. Right lobe shows consistent micro-serrations with a sharp upward-curving distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to prominently convex, hooked distal tips (acuminate shape).

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct circular low-intensity clusters on the left lobe; one smaller circular cluster on the right lobe near the median notch boundary.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant series of dark, roughly parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the right lobe white field; additional fine horizontal scratches visible on the inner-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular tissue loss and jagged contouring along the trailing edges indicative of previous physical impact or predation; sharp, deep notch on the upper-left trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark vertical pigmentation band originating from the peduncle and bifurcating slightly into the white field of the fluke lobes.
